steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each bank transaction is matched to a ledger entry. An unmatched item or a different amount is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 matched pair has a different amount

findings.title: Matched pair with a different amount
findings.fix: Find the difference and correct the ledger

findings.title: Bank transaction with no ledger entry
findings.fix: Record the entry or query the bank

findings.title: Ledger entry with no bank transaction

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).

[medium] txn-0402.md:19  Bank transaction with no ledger entry.
       Fix: Record the entry or query the bank.
[low] ledger-0402.md:26  Ledger entry with no bank transaction.

Not checked: Bank errors outside the statement.
pros: Checks an unmatched bank transaction, an unmatched ledger entry, and a matched pair with a different amount.
cons: Not checked: Bank errors outside the statement.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-bank-reconciliation skill on the records for this review.
